links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified online aortic stenosis patient education materials (pre-conversion readability)
links.outcome: Readability of patient education materials (FRE, FKGL, SMOGI, GFI) before vs after LLM rewriting
links.effect: Original materials were at about a 10th-12th grade level. ChatGPT-3.5 improved all four measures (p < 0.001) to about 6th-7th grade. Bard improved all measures (p < 0.001) except SMOGI (p = 0.729) to about 8th-9th grade. ChatGPT-3.5 outperformed Bard on post-conversion scores, percentage change and conversion time (all p < 0.001).
links.tradeoff: Neither platform produced materials below the recommended 6th-grade level. Bard did not improve SMOGI and was slower than ChatGPT-3.5. The abstract does not report accuracy or content checks of the simplified text.
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 successfully improved readability across all four measures (p < 0.001) to the approximately 6th-7th grade reading level.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt for patient education materials
